articles.title: 'Kidnapped, tied to tree, set on fire': Social media influencer dies in Punjab
articles.description: Manjeet Kaur died after suffering severe burn injuries from an alleged abduction and attack. She was reportedly taken to a forested area and set on fire near Morinda. Questions have arisen regarding the Punjab Police's alleged failure to record her statement. Chandigarh Police have registered a case of abduction and murder after her death. The investigation now focuses on the events and potential missed opportunities.

articles.title: Nepal floods: Morgues overflow along 200km river trail as grief crosses border
articles.description: Morgues in Nepal are overflowing with bodies from a recent flash flood. Authorities are converting buildings into temporary mortuaries as district facilities are full. Hundreds of security personnel are searching riverbanks for more recovered remains. Bodies are being moved between districts for preservation and identification efforts. Unidentified bodies have also surfaced downstream in Indian districts along the Gandak river.

articles.description: On August 26, Galesburg proudly unveiled Cooke Park, a fully accessible neighborhood space built on the site of the former Cooke Elementary School. The ribbon-cutting ceremony was attended by local officials and community leaders, marking a significant partnership between the government and residents.

articles.title: Inflation data 'concerning': Fed chair Warsh signals rates may need to rise
articles.description: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh has signaled that interest rates might rise in the near future, given that inflation continues to far exceed the central bank's two percent goal. He raised concerns about the persistent underlying price pressures, which have not shown significant improvement. This news prompted bond markets to adjust their forecasts, indicating a likely rate hike on the horizon. Warsh reiterated that managing inflation is a top priority.

articles.title: Bihar Board marksheets to replace ‘fail’ with ‘eligible for skills’ to protect students’ morale
articles.description: Bihar plans to replace the word “fail” on Class 10 and 12 marksheets with “Kaushal ke liye patra” to avoid negatively labelling students. The Education Department will also introduce month-long special classes for Matric supplementary candidates. The move comes alongside broader school reforms, including Saturday no-bag days, creative activities and measures to strengthen student support.

articles.title: India Post GDS Recruitment 2026: Check circle-wise vacancies for 23,757 posts here
articles.description: India Post GDS Recruitment 2026: India Post has announced 23,757 Gramin Dak Sevak vacancies under the July 2026 engagement schedule. Maharashtra has the highest listed circle-wise vacancy count with 2,297 posts, followed by Tamil Nadu with 2,118 and Uttar Pradesh with 1,691. One-Time Registration begins on August 31, while applications can be submitted from September 2 to September 21. Selection will be based on a system-generated merit list using Class 10 marks, followed by document verification and medical examination.

articles.title: Shelley Fabares passes away at 82
articles.description: Actress Shelley Fabares, known for 'The Donna Reed Show' and 'Coach', has passed away. Her family confirmed her death was due to pneumonia following a brief illness. Fabares had previously undergone a liver transplant after battling autoimmune hepatitis. She began her entertainment career as a child and later achieved singing success. Her husband, actor Mike Farrell, survives her.
